meta.title: Task poke
meta.description: Pokes you when a Session task finishes, and when a Session waits for your answer: an in-app card in the top-right corner, a Windows toast, or automatically one of the two depending on whether the window is in front. A task must have run for the configured minimum time; a waiting question always pokes. The card never takes focus and never raises the window, and clicking it opens that Session. Channel, duration threshold, card lifetime, subagent filtering and the Windows application identity are edited from the Configure control on this plugin's row in Plugins.
